title: Vice Beach: Neon Drift Club
description: Tear across sunset Art Deco palms and rain-slicked Liberty bridges in a 3D ASCII convertible — chain drifts, slipstream boosts, paint-trading bumps, and garage upgrades.
controls: W/S or Up/Down to drive, A/D or Left/Right to steer, hold Space to drift, double-tap Space for nitro, C to cycle 4 cameras (including cockpit).

zh-CN.title: 罪恶海滩：霓虹夜飙
zh-CN.description: 开上白色复古敞篷车，在日落棕榈海滩与雨夜自由城大桥狂飙！贴尾吸风、弯道甩尾攒氮气、直接撞飞对手，赢了积分还能进车库改装引擎和撞击装甲。
zh-CN.controls: W/S 或上下键油门刹车，A/D 或左右键转向，入弯按住空格漂移充能，双击空格喷射氮气，C 键切换四种镜头（含第一人称驾驶舱）！
